claim: AR's positive pooled direction is consistent across correlated Gate A settings; site heterogeneity and transportability are neither supported nor refuted
validation_type: completed correlated sensitivity, nested, leave-one-site-out, and metadata audits
effect_summary: 60/60 positive rho; observed range 0.136-0.297; six-site frame 224 slides/209 patients; patient-level site median AR -3.46 to 1.71; six LOO intervals include zero; ScanScope raw ID 280/300; explicit stain field 0/300
source_csv: models/stability_summary.csv; models/stability_contrast_summary.csv; models/stability_qc_report.json; models/ar_site_forest_summary.csv; models/confounder_nested_summary.csv; models/ar_site_characteristics.csv; models/ar_slide_metadata_availability.csv
reliability_tier: Pooled direction supported; site transportability unresolved
limitation: AR descriptors are patient-level, whereas each LOO rho is slide-level with a patient-cluster bootstrap interval. No scanner, stain, or site causality is inferred

claim: Post-hoc endpoint-specific exploratory signal remains, with effect-size and transfer generalizability limited by endpoint, encoder, and scale
endpoint: official PFI; reconstructed recurrence; PFS; DFS; strict recurrence
validation_type: post-hoc correlated sensitivity, common-source sensitivity, and endpoint sensitivity
effect_summary: CONCH means 0.681-0.739; Virchow 0.545-0.658; 1/60 chance-or-worse; CONCH is higher in the current grid; Virchow improves at shared 1.76 mpp; common-498 R2 complete: 498 source patients/85 events and 270 target patients/57 events; 60/60 raw-to-common null relation preserved; 30/30 scale, 20/20 tile, 15/15 encoder directions preserved; individual common-minus-raw shifts -0.0023 to +0.0229; official PFI n=270/42 events; C-index 0.586 [0.482,0.689]; cBioPortal PFS event agreement 1.000

claim: Marker 7 shows no robust incremental value in the completed paired common-cohort analysis
validation_type: same-patient/same-draw paired common-cohort ΔC and ΔIBS
effect_summary: reconstructed grade+image delta C +0.083 [+0.012,+0.157]; official PFI grade+image delta C +0.032 [-0.040,+0.126]; full+image delta C -0.001 [-0.020,+0.019]; M5-M4 delta C -0.006 [-0.021,+0.006]
limitation: all official-PFI paired C-index and IBS intervals include zero; the analysis uses a 153-patient complete-case cohort and multiple imputation was not performed. The reconstructed grade-level C-index interval is positive, but its paired IBS interval, full-model contrasts, hierarchy contrast, and official-PFI contrasts do not establish robust independent or incremental prognostic value

claim: The completed grid is a descriptive correlated sensitivity audit
effect_summary: 360 correlated cells summarized into 72 five-seed configurations and 390 paired contrasts
limitation: Gate A did not overturn prior directional observations; it bounded generalizability across configuration, endpoint, encoder, and site. Insufficient evidence remains unresolved rather than contrary evidence; the same cohorts and folds make this neither external validation nor independent replication
